name: Wan Chi Wai, Thomas
reason: No own Quantum-Touch site: the site on his profile, anusarva.com.hk, is Anusarva Spiritual Workshop (思妙心靈工作室, Kwun Tong, Hong Kong), a studio he co-founded in 2014 with astrologer Nirdosh Anusarva (Anne); it is centred on astrology, tarot, numerology and shamanic journeys, lists Quantum-Touch only among his many credentials (hypnotherapy, child play therapy, family therapy and others) and has no Quantum-Touch sessions or workshops. The studio could be a future organisation listing, but its 2027 Brazil trip is a series of 'traditional Brazilian shamanic ceremonies' in the forest (no plant medicine named on the page); the owner should check that for psychedelics before any listing.
